item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las dbus gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod kyi mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar sprang po kho bo yang / o rgyan dur khrod chen por phyin/ ma cig gtso mos dbang lung mdzad/ bka' lung man ngag gdams pa thob/ bdag la lung bstan mdzad tshul gyi/ rnam thar gsal byed sgron ma 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / ma sring gnyen la mthol lo bshags/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ kha ba can gyis (gyi) bod yul du/ bstan pa dar rgyas bkra shis shog/
